sentences.en: WOMAN: I'm very pleased to welcome this evening's guest speaker, Mark Logan, who's going to tell us about the recent transformation of Minster Park.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我非常高兴地欢迎今晚的嘉宾主讲人马克·洛根，他将为我们介绍敏斯特公园近期的改造情况。

sentences.en: Over to you, Mark.
sentences.zh: 接下来有请马克。

sentences.en: MARK: Thank you.
sentences.zh: MARK: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm sure you're all familiar with Minster Park.
sentences.zh: 我相信大家对敏斯特公园都很熟悉。

sentences.en: It's been a feature of the city for well over a century, and has been the responsibility of the city council for most of that time.
sentences.zh: 它已成为这座城市一个特色景点，已有超过一个世纪的历史，而且在大部分时间里都由市议会负责管理。

sentences.en: What perhaps isn't so well known is the origin of the park: unlike many public parks that started in private ownership, as the garden of a large house, for instance, Minster was some waste land, which people living.
sentences.zh: 或许鲜为人知的是这座公园的起源：与许多起源于私人拥有的公共公园（例如某座大宅的花园）不同，敏斯特公园最初是一片荒地，附近居民

sentences.en: nearby started planting with flowers in 1892.
sentences.zh: 于1892年开始在这片土地上种植花卉。

sentences.en: It was unclear who actually owned the land, and this wasn't settled until 20 years later, when the council took possession of it.
sentences.zh: 当时尚不清楚这片土地的实际所有者是谁，这一问题直到20年后市议会接管该地块时才得以解决。

sentences.en: You may have noticed the statue near one of the entrances.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经注意到其中一个入口附近的雕像。

sentences.en: It's of Diane Gosforth, who played a key role in the history of the park.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像是戴安娜·戈斯福德，她在公园的历史上发挥了关键作用。

sentences.en: Once the council had become the legal owner, it planned to sell the land for housing.
sentences.zh: 一旦市议会成为这片土地的合法所有者，便计划将其出售用于住宅建设。

sentences.en: Many local people wanted it to remain a place that everyone could go to, to enjoy the fresh air and natural environment - remember the park is in a densely populated residential area.
sentences.zh: 许多当地居民希望它能继续作为一处人人皆可前往、享受新鲜空气与自然环境的场所——请记住，这座公园位于人口密集的住宅区。

sentences.en: Diane Gosforth was one of those people, and she organised petitions and demonstrations, which eventually made the council change its mind about the future of the land.
sentences.zh: 戴安娜·戈斯福德便是其中一员，她组织了请愿活动和示威游行，最终促使市议会改变了对这片土地未来用途的决定。

sentences.en: Soon after this the First World War broke out, in 1914, and most of the park was dug up and planted with vegetables, which were sold locally.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，第一次世界大战于1914年爆发，公园大部分区域被翻耕并种植蔬菜，所产蔬菜在当地销售。

sentences.en: At one stage the army considered taking it over for troop exercises and got as far as contacting the city council, then decided the park was too small to be of use.
sentences.zh: 战争期间，军队一度考虑将公园征用为部队训练场地，并已联系市议会，但后来认定该公园面积过小，无法满足需求。

sentences.en: There were occasional public meetings during the war, in an area that had been retained as grass.
sentences.zh: 战争期间，曾在保留为草地的一片区域偶尔举行公众集会。

sentences.en: After the war, the park was turned back more or less to how it had been before 1914, and continued almost unchanged until recently.
sentences.zh: 战后，公园基本恢复至1914年以前的样貌，并几乎保持不变，直至最近。

sentences.en: Plans for transforming it were drawn up at various times, most recently in 2013, though they were revised in 2015, before any work had started.
sentences.zh: 对它的改造计划曾在不同时期制定过，最近一次是在2013年，不过该计划于2015年进行了修订，而此时工程尚未启动。

sentences.en: The changes finally got going in 2016, and were finished on schedule last year.
sentences.zh: 改造工作最终于2016年正式启动，并于去年如期完工。

sentences.en: OK, let me tell you about some of the changes that have been made - and some things that have been retained.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我为大家介绍一下已实施的一些改造措施——以及一些被保留下来的内容。

sentences.en: If you look at this map, you'll see the familiar outline of the park, with the river forming the northern boundary, and a gate In each of the other three walls.
sentences.zh: 如果您看一下这张地图，就会看到公园熟悉的轮廓：北侧以河流为界，其余三面围墙各设有一座大门。

sentences.en: The statue of Diane Gosforth has been moved: it used to be close to the south gate, but it's now immediately to the north of the lily.
sentences.zh: 戴安娜·戈斯沃思的雕像已被移位：它原先靠近南门，如今则位于睡莲池正北侧。

sentences.en: pond, almost in the centre of the park, which makes it much more visible.
sentences.zh: 睡莲池几乎位于公园正中央，因此变得醒目得多。

sentences.en: There's a new area of wooden sculptures, which are on the river bank, where the path from the east gate makes a sharp bend.
sentences.zh: 河岸上新增了一处木雕艺术区，位置就在从东门延伸而出的小路急剧转弯处。

sentences.en: There are two areas that are particularly intended for children.
sentences.zh: 公园内有两处区域特别专为儿童设计。

sentences.en: The playground has been enlarged and improved, and that's ween the river and the path that leads from the pond to the river.
sentences.zh: 游乐场已扩建并升级，位于河流与从睡莲池通往河流的小路之间。

sentences.en: Then there's a new maze, a circular series of paths, separated by low hedges.
sentences.zh: 此外还新建了一座迷宫，由一系列呈环形分布的小径组成，小径之间以低矮树篱相隔。

sentences.en: That's near the west gate - you go north from there towards the river and then turn left to reach it.
sentences.zh: 迷宫靠近西门——从西门向北朝河流方向走，然后左转即可到达。

sentences.en: There have been tennis courts in the park for many years, and they've been doubled. from four to eight.
sentences.zh: 公园内多年来一直设有网球场，如今数量已翻倍，由原来的四片增至八片。

sentences.en: They're still in the south-west corner of the park.
sentences.zh: 它们仍位于公园西南角。

sentences.en: where there's a right-angle bend in the path.
sentences.zh: 此处小路呈直角转弯。

sentences.en: Something else I'd like to mention is the new fitness area.
sentences.zh: 我还想提一下新设的健身区。

sentences.en: This is right next to the lily pond on the same side as the west gate.
sentences.zh: 健身区紧邻睡莲池，且与西门位于同一侧。

sentences.en: Now, as you're all gardeners, I'm sure you'll like to hear about the plants that have been chosen for the park.
sentences.zh: 现在，既然各位都是园艺爱好者，我相信大家一定很乐意了解为公园精心挑选的植物品种。
